description: Today page progress bar and Tracked/Remaining cards rewound to their session-start values when 'Finished for today' was clicked while the timer was still running. The DB was correct, so the numbers self-repaired on tab switch or restart. Cause: Today.tsx kept a stale entries snapshot (the 15s flush writes to the DB but only broadcasts timer:update), masked while running because trackedMinutes swaps the active project's stale row for the live clock. timer.stop() clears activeProjectId, and the reload effect was guarded by if (status !== 'idle') - so it skipped exactly the transition that needed it. Pausing first worked because pause() lands on 'paused', which passed the guard.
resolution: Merged the mount effect and the guarded effect into one unguarded useEffect(() => { load(); }, [load, timerState.status, timerState.activeProjectId]). Net deletion. Safe because timer:update is not emitted on the 15s flush, and stop() writes to SQLite synchronously before main broadcasts.

name: Full-screen effects need their own warm window
description: Shelltime's finish-for-today firework lives in a dedicated BrowserWindow (confetti.html / src/confetti.tsx / src/components/Confetti.tsx), not in App. An Electron window can't paint outside its bounds, so a burst rendered in the main window is invisible when the user finished from the popout, and one in the popout is a 340px stamp. createConfettiWindow() builds it hidden at startup (transparent, focusable:false, setIgnoreMouseEvents, backgroundThrottling:false) and keeps it warm; showConfetti() only setBounds to the display under the cursor, re-asserts alwaysOnTop 'screen-saver', showInactive, then calls window.__fireConfetti() via executeJavaScript. Building the window on the click cost ~2s of dead air; warm it is 16ms. __fireConfetti returns CONFETTI_TOTAL_MS so the duration is defined once in the component and main just schedules the hide. No preload for that window - executeJavaScript is enough for a one-way trigger that returns a value.
